note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: the unit moved verbatim to core rfc8955_vpn_test.go, with only the family identifier renamed (test-local AFI 1/SAFI 134). RFC 8955 Section 8: "The NLRI format for this address family consists of a fixed-length Route Distinguisher field (8 octets) followed by the Flow Specification NLRI value (Section 4.2)." The positive decodes RD 100:100 from the 8 octets after the length and the destination component after them, and requires the exact wire back from WriteTo. The negative requires ErrFlowSpecTruncated from core ParseFlowSpecVPN for a length too short to hold the RD.
